data.summary: Schlüsseldienst Beispielriegel sends a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) for their invoice of 27 October 2026 covering an emergency door opening and cylinder replacement on 26 October 2026. The outstanding amount of €148.75 is to be paid by Wednesday, 9 December 2026.
data.explanation: This locksmith company performed an emergency door opening and lock cylinder replacement for you and says your invoice of €148.75 is still unpaid. You are asked to pay this amount by 9 December 2026. Check your records to confirm whether you already paid this invoice; if so, keep proof of payment in case of further contact. If not, transfer the amount to the IBAN shown using the order number as reference, to avoid further reminders or collection steps. This type of craftsman service (Handwerkerleistung) for your home may be tax-deductible, so keep the invoice for your tax return.

items.title: Pay the outstanding locksmith invoice
items.action: Transfer €148.75 to the locksmith's account referencing the order number SR-26-0871.

key_facts.quote: am 26.10.2026 haben wir Ihre zugefallene Wohnungstür geöffnet und den Schließzylinder ersetzt.

key_facts.quote: Unsere Rechnung über 148,75 € ist noch offen.

data.tax_note: Craftsman call-out services for the home (Handwerkerleistungen) like this door opening and lock replacement can be partly deductible from income tax under §35a EStG; keep the invoice and proof of bank transfer (cash payments do not qualify).
